candidates.name: schur
candidates.choice: Existing native PCFIELDSPLIT velocity/pressure IS + full Schur + selfp + GAMG on both blocks

P1_protocol.preferred_initial_state: original GPU step10 BIN, with independent global-node state correspondence to step10 VTU before solving; if correspondence fails, no use of this checkpoint
P1_protocol.controlled_segment: step10 -> step11, dt .01, same initial Y/A, residual/Jacobian and all tolerances
P1_protocol.initial_R_J: first native PETSc matrix/RHS byte-identical hashes across all runs
P1_protocol.convergence: All KSP positive reason; nonlinear native tolerance1e-10; <=24 nonlinear iterations; candidate wall<=1800s; KSPmax2000 unchanged; total Krylov <=10x baseline
P1_protocol.GPU: all Mat/Vec CUDA, CPU PC where implemented

P2_safety.accounting: limit minus conservative nonreclaimable upper; raw memory.current and reclaimable cache reported separately
